# ankra_cloudflare_credentials (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's connected Cloudflare credentials; tokens are never returned. The counterpart of `ankra org cloudflare credentials`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cloudflare_credentials" "all" {}

output "needs_reconnect" {
  value = [for credential in data.ankra_cloudflare_credentials.all.credentials : credential.name if credential.needs_reconnect]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) Cloudflare credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account id.
- `account_name` (String) Cloudflare account name.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `needs_reconnect` (Boolean) Whether the token is gone and must be connected again.
- `state` (String) Health of the credential.
- `token_expires_at` (String) When the token expires, if it does.
- `token_kind` (String) Whether the token is user-owned or account-owned.
